text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 02 · 电影夜景 · 极夜冰川观测穹顶 · 靛蓝 / 极光绿 / 金黄.
Environment: Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Photoreal cinematic polar research observatory, low curved glass dome on a glacier, aurora sweeping over icy mountains, warmly illuminated interior visible through curved glass, cobalt snow and emerald sky, finely resolved frost, gentle film halation, wide environment with empty foreground.
Visual medium: cinematic night; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Reconstruct the SAME scene from reference 1 concept plan, reference 2 original look. Match plan footprint, fixed window/door/stair/furniture positions. Scene: 多画风场景20组 · 02 · 电影夜景 · 极夜冰川观测穹顶 · 靛蓝 / 极光绿 / 金黄. One large roofless axonometric 3D dollhouse cutaway of the entire plan, coherent wall heights, all key furnishings and access visible, white page. For outdoors a raised site massing model. Preserve reference materials, light and style. Unseen extension conservative. Empty environment, NO people, animals, silhouettes, statues of humans, no unrelated spaces. Landscape image, no dimensions. IMPORTANT: Reference 2 ORIGINAL image determines artistic medium and color grading; keep watercolor / impasto painting / cel animation / clay miniature respectively. Reference 1 only determines spatial layout, NOT render style. Do not homogenize all scenes into photorealism.
